findings.description: SYS-SUP-003 requires detection when a task starts late but sets no detection deadline. CON-SUP-105 measures the safe-state reaction from expiry of a timing limit; OP-SYS-010 leaves detection of a task that never starts unresolved.
findings.requested_change: Classify OP-SYS-010 as blocking and obtain a decision on the late-start detection instant.

findings.description: SYS-SUP-003 accepts a start at the limit and rejects a later start, while CON-SUP-103 specifies 100 µs measurement resolution. OP-SYS-009 leaves classification of starts in the measurement step containing the limit unresolved.
findings.requested_change: Classify OP-SYS-009 as blocking and obtain a decision that permits a boundary verdict.

findings.description: SYS-SUP-014 detects a mismatch against a stored reference, but OP-SYS-004 leaves the reference and comparison method undefined. The expected detection of changes to the application image cannot be established.
findings.requested_change: Classify OP-SYS-004 as blocking and obtain a decision defining the reference and comparison sufficiently to verify the check.

findings.description: CON-SUP-112 requires milliseconds since start, but OP-SYS-006 leaves the timestamp origin and wrap behavior undefined. Expected report values across resets and counter wrap cannot be determined.
findings.requested_change: Classify OP-SYS-006 as blocking and obtain decisions on the timestamp origin and wrap behavior.

findings.description: OP-SYS-005 leaves the status state values and the meaning of fault count undefined, so the expected GET STATUS response cannot be determined for a given operating and reset history.
findings.requested_change: Classify OP-SYS-005 as blocking and obtain decisions defining the state values and fault count.

findings.description: SYS-SUP-004 requires detection at expiry while accepting completion at that instant. OP-SYS-009 leaves treatment of a completion in the same 100 µs measurement step as expiry unspecified, preventing a boundary verdict.
findings.requested_change: Classify OP-SYS-009 as blocking and obtain a decision on the expiry boundary and measurement resolution.

findings.description: SYS-SUP-003 detects a late-start fault only when the task starts, while CON-SUP-105 measures the reaction from expiry of a timing limit. OP-SYS-010 defers the detection instant for a task that never starts, leaving its timely response unresolved.
findings.requested_change: Classify OP-SYS-010 as blocking and obtain a decision on detection and reaction for a task that has not started.

findings.description: SYS-SUP-024 requires an entity in every fault report. SYS-SUP-049 defines the code 4 entity only for missing checkpoints when received checkpoints are in order; OP-SYS-013 records that the entity for out-of-order or mixed cases remains undecided under CON-SUP-122.
findings.requested_change: Obtain the decision recorded in OP-SYS-013 and specify the code 4 entity for the remaining flow-fault cases.
